seo.title: FAQ — Stoic Finch
seo.description: Common questions about engagements, pricing, team composition, tools and timelines.

hero.headline: Frequently asked questions
hero.subheadline: Answers to the questions prospects ask us most often.

items.question: How do you typically engage?
items.answer: Three models: Consultation (1–4 weeks discovery + advisory), Development (project-based build with milestones), Ongoing Maintenance (monthly retainer for managed analytics/pipelines/models).

items.question: What tools do you work with?
items.answer: Python, Power BI, Tableau, PostgreSQL, Pandas, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Jupyter, Git — plus cloud-native stacks on Azure, AWS and GCP. We pick the tool that fits your existing ecosystem.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: Born in Calgary, Alberta 🇨🇦. Delivered globally — most engagements are remote or hybrid, with on-site options for Calgary/Alberta clients.

items.question: Do you publish pricing?
items.answer: No — scope, seniority, and timeline vary too much. We quote per engagement after a free consultation. Typical engagements range from single-sprint discoveries to multi-quarter retainers.

items.question: What's the smallest engagement you take?
items.answer: A 1–2 week discovery is a common starting point. We use it to map your data landscape and agree on where to invest first.
